question: West Bengal shares its longest border with which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal is a state located in the eastern part of India and shares its borders with three countries, namely, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh.**
 
• Bangladesh is the country that shares the longest border with West Bengal, which is** approximately 2,217 km long.**
 
• The border between West Bengal and Bangladesh is a porous one, with many illegal crossings and smuggling activities taking place.
 
• The Indo-Bangladesh border is also known as the International Border (IB) and is guarded by the Border Security Force (BSF) on the Indian side and the Border Guards Bangladesh (BGB) on the Bangladeshi side.
 
• West Bengal has 3 international boundaries.
 
• West Bengal has international boundaries with Bangladesh in the east, Bhutan in the North, and Nepal in the northwest.
 
• West Bengal with 2,217 km (**1377.58** miles) shares the longest border with Bangladesh.
 
 
• It is the fifth-longest land border in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhutan shares a 183 km long border** with West Bengal, which is mostly mountainous and forested.
 
• **Nepal shares a 1,751 km** long border with India, of which 97 km is shared with West Bengal. This border is also mostly mountainous and forested.
 
• **Myanmar shares a 1,643 km** long border with India, of which 262 km is shared with West Bengal. This border is also known as the Indo-Myanmar border and is guarded by the Assam Rifles on the Indian side.
 
• **China shares a 3,488 km** long border with India, of which 1,597 km is shared with the state of Arunachal Pradesh. West Bengal does not share a border with China.
